metadata.authorship: Dev supplies the few-shot examples. Test shares one exact development example and several paraphrases; it is optimistic and not independent. Known-cases informed the guardrails and prompt instructions. Test scores were not used to tune the policy.

split_provenance.dev: 104 development messages used for few-shot examples and development.
split_provenance.test: 102 synthetic messages written during development by the same authors after design feedback; one shared exact example and several paraphrases. In-distribution, optimistic and not independent. Scores were not used to tune the policy.
split_provenance.known-cases: 15 development design cases used for guardrails and prompt instructions; not held out.
split_provenance.blind: 50 synthetic messages: 25 each from Gemini and Grok in fresh chats with no project context, using only intent definitions. Labels were checked by hand before evaluation (x22: unclear; x23: escalate); messages and labels are frozen.
split_provenance.options: Four suggested phrases declared separately and recorded with the live model. A small routing check, not an independent accuracy set.
